description: Add a user preference to enable or disable automatic arrow binding to elements. When disabled, arrows will not automatically bind to nearby elements, giving users more control over arrow placement and connections. This preference should be accessible via the UI and persist across sessions.
functional_requirements: Add a toggle in the UI (likely in properties panel or settings) to enable/disable arrow binding
When disabled, arrows should not automatically bind to elements during creation or movement
The preference state should be saved to app state and persist across user sessions
Update the arrow creation and editing logic to respect this preference setting
Ensure existing arrow bindings are preserved when the preference is toggled (don't break existing diagrams)
